about: Questions the meetings do not answer, or that rest on a false premise. The right reply is a clear no, never a made-up answer (D-033). Absence was checked by searching every turn and ledger event of the team. Own set, not from questions.json. O-questions are outside the meetings altogether (writing, general knowledge, code, instructions to the AI): the right reply is a fixed refusal (D-038).
